description: DILHUE crystallizes in the triclinic crystal system with space group P -1. Reported CIF formula moiety: C50 H80 F24 O40 S8 Sm4. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 4.580-4.580 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 148.88-148.88°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [Sm4(μ3-CO3)2(μ2-OTf)6(OTf)2(THF)10]. Article name explicitly identifies I(II).
